story.title: Built to Make Industrial Sourcing More Reliable
paragraphs: Prince Pipes & Fittings was established in 2022 with a clear focus on quality, dependable supply and customer service.
The company operates from a fully stocked warehouse in Mumbai, helping maintain product availability and support prompt service.
PPF specialises in the supply and sale of steel fittings for pipes, including Buttweld and Socketweld fittings, flanges and related industrial components.
The catalogue highlights close coordination with manufacturers to supply products conforming to relevant European standards and certification requirements.
